## Context / Problem
The 7–21 Aug 2026 defect review (221 bug tickets, 196 real, 56 git-dated to changes inside the window) found that every hotspot is the same decision written in two to seven places: a fix lands in one copy and its twin stays broken, so families arrive as three-ticket instalments (sidecar keying ×3, git_adapter by-path loads ×3, nested-pytest --basetemp ×3, comment key/send fit ×5, compaction ×6). The spawner consolidation (`c98d976199`) and its static guard `tests/unit/test_spawn_detached.py::test_the_detached_spawn_signature_appears_only_in_proc` showed the durable shape: one implementation plus a test that a second copy cannot merge (`7213e082b5` was caught by it two days later).

## Approach
Each child collapses one duplicated computation into one shared module, keeps every current behaviour pinned by the tests named in the child, and lands with a construct-uniqueness guard that asserts on the construct's distinctive atoms (not on internals), with an explicit `# <construct>-ok: <reason>` escape marker as `scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py` uses. Children are independent; order by blast radius (store paths and stamped lock first, merge recovery last).

## Guard-test construction rule (applies to every child; approved 2026-08-21)
A construct-uniqueness guard pins how MANY implementations exist, never how the one implementation works. Build it as `tests/unit/test_spawn_detached.py::test_the_detached_spawn_signature_appears_only_in_proc` is built:
1. Scan every file under `src/rebar` EXCEPT the owner module; refactoring inside the owner cannot fail the guard.
2. Match on the conjunction of atoms that constitute the construct (for example `os.O_EXCL` together with `stamped_file_is_stale`), or on an AST shape (call target plus argument position) as `scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py` does — never on a single common token such as `os.open` or `.lock`.
3. Provide a line marker with a mandatory reason (`# <construct>-ok: <why>`) for a legitimate second use, so the exception is visible in review instead of silently absent.
4. Where the construct has no distinctive atoms, assert the definition count of the named symbol instead (exactly one `def <name>` under `src/rebar`).
5. The guard proves uniqueness only. Behaviour preservation is proven by the pinning tests each child names, which must pass with no assertion edits.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_store/`, `src/rebar/_commands/` (transition/close/compaction), `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/` (outbound comments), `src/rebar/llm/` (runtime, failure, gate dispatch), `src/rebar/_mcp_*.py`, `tests/` helpers and guards, `.github/workflows/` (predates-gate guard).

## Acceptance Criteria

This epic carries **two child classes with different guarantees**, and the criteria below are
scoped accordingly. The **consolidation children** — the fourteen named under "Child
responsibilities" — collapse duplicated logic and are held to no-behaviour-change plus
net-negative lines. The **hardening children** (`dormant-fibre-pterosaurs`,
`tireless-ruinable-prairiedog`, `bold-abeyant-indri`, `amenable-befuddling-phoenix`,
`nitro-zombie-mealworm`, `diabetic-inorganic-equine`, `emulsible-beneficent-caiman`,
`compliable-evaluable-mamba`, `tectonic-toxophilic-limpet`) close the process gaps the same
defect review found: they deliberately ADD behaviour and lines, so the two consolidation
guarantees do not apply to them and they are governed by their own recorded criteria.

- [ ] Every duplicated computation inventoried in the review has exactly one implementation on `main`, each delivered by one consolidation child; checked by that child's construct-uniqueness test passing in the default `Verified` tier.
- [ ] No **consolidation** child changes a PINNED observable behaviour: the pinning tests each such child names pass unchanged (no edits to their assertions); checked by `git diff --stat origin/main -- tests/` of each landed change showing only additions. Where collapsing copies also converges a latent divergence — a copy that lacked a fix its twins already carried — the child records that convergence explicitly in its own description and covers it with a new test; the guarantee is that no PINNED behaviour changes silently.
- [ ] The net non-test line count across the **consolidation** children's landed changes is negative; checked by summing `git show --numstat` over those children's trailer commits.
- [ ] Each **hardening** child meets its own recorded acceptance criteria; checked by that child's own close gate (completion verification + execution-phase plan review).
